subject: PRODUCTION OUTAGE - API down, customers affected
body: Our production API has been returning 500s for the last 20 minutes. This is impacting all customers. We need someone to jump on a call immediately and acknowledge before the SLA window closes today.
why: Explicit outage plus a same-day SLA deadline. Time pressure outranks everything else.

subject: Cut your reporting time by 40% with GrowthTools
body: Hi there, I noticed your team is scaling fast. GrowthTools helps companies like yours automate analytics dashboards. Would you be open to a quick 15-minute demo next week? No rush at all.
why: Cold outreach with a soft ask and no deadline. 'No rush at all' is the signal that keeps it out of urgent.

subject: Dinner this weekend?
body: Hey! It has been way too long since we caught up. Are you free for dinner on Saturday? Thinking that little Italian place we love. Let me know what works for you!
why: Informal register, shared history, social invitation. No commercial intent.

subject: Congratulations!!! You have WON a $1,000 gift card
body: Dear lucky user, you have been selected to receive a $1000 Amazon gift card. Click the link below within 24 hours to claim your prize now. Verify your details to release funds.
why: Prize claim plus credential harvesting. Note the 24-hour deadline does NOT make it urgent — fraud signals win.
